# ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10: setupEffect carries the operator's new attempt

## Context

ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10 declares the setup card's wire. For a host effect it reads `setupEffect({effectId})` → `{ok: true, evaluation}` (`learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md:298`). The Institution's setup card needs one more consent on that request, and its broker's reply rule changed. Both planners accepted this leaf on 2026-10-04 ([gap line](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/351#issuecomment-5979904322)), with one condition from the row's design seat: this clause lands with or before the Brain's row contract (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#840), never after.

## The Problem

- **The witness has an exit the wire cannot carry.** The Brain's `verify` effect writes its first-run witness once. After a write the plane refused, or an acknowledgement that was lost and not found again, only the operator's explicit `newAttempt` writes a second time. The declared request has no field for it, so the card's `run` on such a row can never succeed ([intake and probe](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/481#issuecomment-5979808017)).
- **The reply rule is not stated.** The item says when the shell answers `{ok: true, evaluation}`; it does not say what a report from the orchestration does to the reply. The broker's rule is now: an effect whose own receipt moved answers the re-evaluated run, and only a report that moved nothing is a refusal (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#481).

## The Architectural Reality

- The request is one consented host effect through the Brain's shared orchestration; main forwards it and never implements an effect itself.
- `newAttempt` is the orchestration's own parameter (`performEffects`, `performVerify`); the wire would forward it, not invent it.
- The sibling clause for a fresh run is neomjs/neo#19382, parked with its consumer.
- ADR 0005 §6.5: an ADR revision is its own PR, ahead of the implementation.

## The Fix

Amend item 10's `setupEffect` clause:

- the request is `setupEffect({effectId, newAttempt})`; `newAttempt: true` is admitted only for `effectId: 'verify'` and only when the evaluated row names a new attempt as its exit; anything else is refused by name;
- it is forwarded as the operator's explicit consent, and a possible duplicate row is the consent's stated cost;
- the reply rule: an effect that ran answers `{ok: true, evaluation}` whatever came of it; a report that moved nothing answers `{ok: false, reason, effectId}`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Item 10 states the request shape, the admission rule for `newAttempt`, its refusal, and what the consent costs.
- [ ] Item 10 states the reply rule for an effect that ran and for a report that moved nothing.
- [ ] The text names the Brain's evaluated row as the source of the exit; the card and main parse no reason sentence.
- [ ] It merges before, or together with, neomjs/neo-agent-brain#840.

## Out of Scope

- The fresh-run flag (neomjs/neo#19382).
- Any behaviour: the Brain's contract is neomjs/neo-agent-brain#840 and the card's consumer is its own Institution leaf.
